info.name: Event Registration & Management API
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint of the Group11 event API (`/api/v1`).

1. Import this collection and `local.postman_environment.json`, select the "Event API – Local" environment.
2. Start the API (`npm run dev`).
3. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Tokens and ids are saved automatically.

Every response uses `{ success, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details } }`. Prices are in kobo.

exec: // One id per run so sign-up emails are unique. Clear the runId variable to start fresh.
// Every API error has the same envelope.

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: Is the API up and connected to MongoDB?

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Sign-up and login save tokens into collection variables, so later requests are authenticated automatically.

request.description: Creates an organizer account. Emails include {{runId}} so the collection can be re-run.
Role defaults to attendee. Use a real address in attendeeEmail if you want to receive the ticket email via Brevo.
Used for the paid ticket flow (one registration per user per event).

exec: pm.test('admin logged in (set adminEmail/adminPassword in the environment)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200));

request.description: There is no admin sign-up. Make a user admin in the database (users collection → role: "admin"), then put its credentials in the environment.
Refresh tokens rotate: the old one stops working once used.
Always 200. The reset link is emailed (or logged when no email provider is configured).
Paste the token from the reset email into the resetToken variable first. Expect 400 with a placeholder token.

item.name: 2. Events & tickets
item.description: Organizer creates a draft event, adds a free and a paid ticket type, then publishes it.

exec: // Event starts a week from now and lasts 4 hours.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman Fest {{runId}}",
  "description": "Created from the Postman collection",
  "category": "music",
  "venue": {
    "name": "Eko Hall",
    "address": "1 Marina",
    "city": "Lagos"
  },
  "startAt": "{{eventStart}}",
  "endAt": "{{eventEnd}}",
  "capacity": 100,
  "refundPolicy": "full"
}

request.description: Prices are in kobo: 500000 = ₦5,000.
Back to draft (allowed while nobody has registered; 409 HAS_REGISTRATIONS otherwise). The next request publishes it again.
Choose a JPEG/PNG/WebP (max 5 MB) for the "banner" field. Without a file you get 400; returns 503 when Cloudinary is not configured.
Other filters: from, to, minPrice, maxPrice, isFree=true|false. limit max 50.

item.name: 3. Registration
item.description: Free tickets confirm instantly with a QR token; paid tickets return a checkout URL and hold the seat for 15 minutes.

request.description: In demo mode the checkoutUrl opens a local demo checkout page with Pay / Decline buttons.
Postman previews the image. Add inline=true to display instead of download in a browser. Use "Save response → Save to a file" to keep it.

item.name: 4. Payments (Paystack demo)
item.description: Complete the paid registration without a Paystack account. Works when the API runs with PAYSTACK_MODE=demo (the default).

request.description: Returns the checkout URL for a pending registration (e.g. if it was lost).
The page the attendee sees. Open {{checkoutUrl}} in a browser to click Pay / Decline.
Simulates Paystack calling the webhook: confirms the registration and emails the QR ticket. Use outcome "failed" to simulate a decline.

exec: // Paystack signs the raw body with HMAC-SHA512 using the secret key.

request.description: Sends a signed charge.success for the same reference. Because the demo payment already processed it, the API answers { duplicate: true }. paystackSecret must equal the API's PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY (demo default: sk_demo_local_secret).

item.name: 5. Check-in
item.description: Organizer scans the QR token at the door. A ticket can be used once.

item.name: 6. Reports
item.description: Organizer dashboard data for their own event.

request.description: Registrations by status, revenue, check-in rate and finance (gross, platform fee, organizer net, held, payout).

item.name: 7. Payouts
item.description: Organizer bank account and payouts (paid after the event ends + hold period).

request.description: In demo mode the Paystack transfer recipient is simulated. The account number is masked in responses.
Empty until the event has ended and PAYOUT_HOLD_DAYS have passed.

item.name: 8. Admin
item.description: Requires the "Login (admin)" request to have succeeded.

request.description: Set payoutId to a failed or awaiting_account payout first.
draft | published | completed | cancelled. Cancelling refunds every attendee.

item.name: 9. Cleanup
item.description: Run last. Cancels the paid ticket (refunded: event policy is "full") and cancels the event.

request.description: Hard-deletes an event nobody registered for; otherwise cancels it, refunds and notifies attendees.
